description: This file is a makefile or build configuration script specific to the OpenWRT build system. It defines package configurations, dependencies, firmware sources, download procedures, kernel module parameters, and build/install rules for Broadcom wireless drivers such as b43, brcmutil, brcmsmac, and brcmfmac.

methods.name: Download/b43
methods.description: Defines the download details for the b43 firmware source, including URL and hash.

methods.name: KernelPackage/b43
methods.description: Defines the kernel module package parameters for Broadcom 43xx wireless support, including dependencies, files, and load behavior.

methods.name: KernelPackage/b43/config
methods.description: Contains configuration options for selecting firmware versions, supported PHYs, buses, and debug options for b43.

methods.name: KernelPackage/b43/description
methods.description: Provides a brief description of the b43 kernel module as Broadcom 43xx wireless support.

methods.name: KernelPackage/brcmutil
methods.description: Defines the Broadcom IEEE802.11n common driver parts with firmware and debug support.

methods.name: KernelPackage/brcmutil/description
methods.description: Describes that this module contains common parts needed by Broadcom wireless drivers brcmsmac and brcmfmac.

methods.name: KernelPackage/brcmutil/config
methods.description: Configuration for enabling debugging of Broadcom wireless drivers.

methods.name: KernelPackage/brcmsmac
methods.description: Kernel module for Broadcom IEEE802.11n PCIe WLAN driver.

methods.name: KernelPackage/brcmsmac/description
methods.description: Provides a description indicating support for Broadcom IEEE802.11n PCIe wireless cards.

methods.name: KernelPackage/brcmsmac/config
methods.description: Configuration options for use of firmware, bus support, and core revision management for brcmsmac.

methods.name: KernelPackage/brcmfmac
methods.description: Kernel module for Broadcom IEEE802.11n USB FullMAC WLAN driver.

methods.name: KernelPackage/brcmfmac/description
methods.description: Support for Broadcom IEEE802.11n USB wireless cards.

methods.name: KernelPackage/brcmfmac/config
methods.description: Configuration options for SDIO, USB, PCIe bus support, and firmware selection for brcmfmac.
